# docs-place-org-era-research

Research collected during the place.org era.

## Stack & contents

Mixed markdown + Next.js TSX excerpts. ~132 files under `host/{place-companion, place.org-openclaw}`. Includes immersive route groups (community, companion, services) and a `TimeMachine` component.

## Why this is here

Captures the **place.org research era** before it merged with OpenClaw. Read `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-03-20-place-org-design.md` for the design intent that the v1.1 desktop surface inherits.

## How to load it efficiently

```bash
git show origin/docs-place-org-era-research:host/place.org-openclaw/docs/openclaw/FORK-ARCHITECTURE.md
git show origin/docs-place-org-era-research:host/place.org-openclaw/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-03-20-place-org-design.md
```
